scope.deduplication_rule: One record per distinct file, selection rule, and consequence. The multi-axis M133 record is split by scorecard gate. M31 is included because summary-06 records it as a resolved artifact check.

consequence_tiers.T0_CURRENT_GATE: Changes or constrains a current scorecard, proposal, capture, or build gate.
consequence_tiers.T1_LIVE_HEADLINE_OR_SHIP: Changes or constrains a live headline, shipped behavior, or active recommendation.
consequence_tiers.T2_SUPPORTING_CONCLUSION: Changes only supporting magnitude, assurance, or generality.
consequence_tiers.T3_ILLUSTRATIVE_OR_HISTORICAL: Illustrative, explicitly historical, or already self-caveated.

verdict_flip.NO: The verdict survives with its stated or replacement scope.
verdict_flip.UNRESOLVED: The missing population evidence could change the verdict.
verdict_flip.NOT_APPLICABLE: No live verdict is carried by the finding.

findings.true_population: The operational first-eight preflight for each tested stack; all frames would be needed to prove within-stack stationarity beyond the preflight.
findings.derivation_or_missing_evidence: The default-ON decision that made this guard load-bearing is later reverted to opt-in/default-OFF. The planted stale and clean controls remain valid for the preflight design, but complete-stack stationarity was not measured.
findings.orchestrator_replacement_text: The first-eight preflight blocks the tested stale-map plants and preserves the tested clean controls. It is not full-stack stationarity evidence, and the later default-OFF reversion removes it as a default-path safety gate.

findings.original_conclusion: The historical exact-equality guard would reject 11 of 26 renderable stacks.
findings.true_population: All frames only if active-area geometry can vary within a stack; one shipping-decoder frame per stack for the recorded stack-level census.
findings.derivation_or_missing_evidence: The source later replaces the false refusal label with the measured admissible mismatch rule and renders the bounded corpus sweep. The historical guard result is retained as the trigger for repair, not a current verdict.
findings.orchestrator_replacement_text: The first-frame geometry census exposed a historical exact-equality guard defect across 11 of 26 stacks. That refusal rule is superseded by the measured mismatch guard; do not report 11 of 26 as a current render failure.

findings.original_conclusion: The temporary default-ON correction rendered all 26 stacks in an eight-frame corpus sweep.
findings.true_population: The first eight frames of all 26 stacks for that sweep; complete brackets for long-fold execution.
findings.derivation_or_missing_evidence: The source explicitly says long-bracket fold behavior is not exercised, and section 13.1 later reverts the default to OFF on separate coordinate adjudication.
findings.orchestrator_replacement_text: The temporary default-ON arm passed a first-eight-frame sweep of all 26 stacks; complete-bracket execution was not measured, and the feature was later reverted to default OFF.

denominator_chain: full-stack execution of corrected sidecars for both subjects
findings.original_conclusion: The reproduction-command fix is commissioned on bounded arms and reproduces the two sealed masters on full-stack replay.
findings.true_population: All frames and every output sample for the final 109MSDCF and foam replays; all 26 sidecars for textual re-emission, but only two for executed full-stack replay.
findings.derivation_or_missing_evidence: Summary-06 incorrectly puts lines 3469-3470 under the first-eight cap. The source labels section 22.6 full stacks and reports 0 DN over all 98,898,048 output samples for each. The first-eight arms commission the gate; the two full-stack arms verify final behavior. The other 24 corrected sidecars were reread textually but not executed full-stack.
findings.orchestrator_replacement_text: The gate was commissioned on first-eight arms, then the corrected 109MSDCF and foam sidecars were executed on full stacks and reproduced every one of 98,898,048 output samples. Execution of the other 24 re-emitted sidecars remains UNMEASURED.

denominator_chain: confirmed-site correction applied to all 19 frame loads
findings.original_conclusion: The first-eight preflight selects the site and scale used for the 19-frame run.
findings.true_population: The operational first-eight validator for its decision; all 19 frames for a full-capture stationarity claim.
findings.derivation_or_missing_evidence: The denominator is explicit and the product behavior intentionally uses the preflight result. Full-capture site validation is absent, so no broader stationarity claim is licensed.
findings.orchestrator_replacement_text: Coffee-bubbles used an eight-frame preflight to confirm 1 of 2 sites and then applied that decision across 19 loads. Full-19-frame site stationarity is UNMEASURED.

findings.original_conclusion: The saved pair independently reproduces the 0.0487 percent changed and 99.9513 percent identical partition.
findings.true_population: Every output pixel in the saved bee-3 first-20 pair. Summary-06's 105-frame coffee-bean population is incorrect for these lines.
findings.derivation_or_missing_evidence: The source names bee3-dust-on/off and gives a complete changed-plus-identical partition. It is not a sample of output pixels, but it remains a first-20 render rather than a full-299 render.
findings.orchestrator_replacement_text: The deleted on/off pair was bee-3-cpl, not coffee-bean. Its complete first-20 output partition was 16,039 changed plus 32,949,977 identical pixels, totaling 32,966,016; do not extend that fraction to a full-299 render.

denominator_chain: 79 files in the source directory inventory
projected decoder seconds for the same 60 files
11.41 percent storage/decode ratio against 20 percent gate
findings.original_conclusion: D15 PASS: storage is not material for the explicitly prefetchable 60-file workload, so no IOCP build is warranted.
findings.true_population: The pre-registered first-60 workload. The 79-file directory is an inventory/read-only control, not the decision population.
findings.derivation_or_missing_evidence: The pre-registration explicitly defines the proposal's prefetchable workload as the first 60 files and compares read and decode time on those same files. No numerator is extrapolated to 79. A production workload outside that registered design is a future-workload trigger, already covered by the reopen rule.
findings.orchestrator_replacement_text: D15 PASS is valid for its pre-registered first-60 prefetchable workload: 11.41 percent of matched decode time against the 20 percent bar. The directory's other 19 files are outside that estimand; reopen IOCP for a newly registered workload that measures at or above 20 percent.

findings.true_population: Every output byte from the exact first-60 command.

findings.orchestrator_replacement_text: M100 B1 PASS is an exact first-60 command byte freeze. A full-299 freeze was not run and is not implied.

findings.original_conclusion: Auto exposure changes from +1.47/+1.48 on prefixes to +1.54 on the complete capture.

findings.orchestrator_replacement_text: The complete bee-3 run chooses +1.54 stops; +1.47 and +1.48 are explicitly prefix-only sensitivity values.

findings.original_conclusion: Fact 1419's provenance is corrected; the full-299 result is more negative and NO-GO survives.

denominator_chain: M24 reference runs capped or strided to at most 40 frames
14-stack decision corpus restricted to 33 through 100 frames
runtime U1 abstention outside that domain

M125 later measures strong frame-count dependence, restricts AUTO_FRAMES_DOMAIN to 33..=100, and demonstrates that the full-299 bee run abstains U1. Default remains OFF.
findings.orchestrator_replacement_text: M125's 40-frame fixtures commission Dpp arithmetic only. The opt-in auto decision is valid only for 33-100 frames and must abstain U1 outside that domain; the default remains OFF.

denominator_chain: first 64 lexically sorted ARWs per stack by registration
four frozen ROI cells per stack

findings.orchestrator_replacement_text: M76 Q1 remains INCONCLUSIVE on its exact registered 24-cell population: only 18 cells are readable, below the frozen minimum of 20. A full-stack rerun is not the missing denominator; a new pre-registered valid fixture would be.

denominator_chain: all map pixels and adjacent pixel pairs in each produced map

findings.original_conclusion: No sparse PDAF anomaly signature was found on the modern Sony body.

denominator_chain: 78.3 percent median bimodality and 7.2 percent background-focus localization

denominator_chain: 19 other residual maps times 132 = 2,508 calibration tiles

With 20 residual maps and 132 origins, calibration is 19 times 132 = 2,508; the tested frame has 132. The nominal 5, 1, and 0.1 percent labels are operating-point names, not measured denominators.

aggregate.headline: Two non-M151 conclusions require denominator downgrades: BUILD-ELECT's every-frame H4 claim and V-bestframe's full-capture H1 claim become UNMEASURED beyond their rendered or sampled frames. M151's 64-to-1,944 capture-ruling reversal is the known historical correction and is excluded from the other-flip count. No current accepted scorecard PASS or FAIL changes: unresolved denominators preserve UNMEASURED or DEFINITION BLOCKED states rather than manufacturing scores.
